name: CIDB Half Marathon 2026
short_description: A road race in Putrajaya, Malaysia, offering 21.1km, 10km, 5km, and 3km distances on December 13, 2026.
ai_summary: The CIDB Half Marathon 2026 is a road race held on December 13, 2026 at Dataran Putrajaya in Putrajaya, Malaysia. Organized by Kelab CIDB WP Kuala Lumpur under the CIDB Run banner, the event offers four distance categories: 21.1km, 10km, 5km, and 3km.

core_facts.organizer: Kelab CIDB WP Kuala Lumpur ("CIDB Run")

pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km, 3km) suit a range of runner abilities
Scenic and well-known venue at Dataran Putrajaya, Putrajaya

faqs.question: When is the CIDB Half Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The CIDB Half Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on December 13, 2026. The race will be held at Dataran Putrajaya in Putrajaya, Malaysia, giving participants a fixed date to plan their travel, training, and race-day logistics well in advance.

faqs.question: What distance options are available at this race?
faqs.answer: Runners can choose from four distance categories at this event: a 21.1km half marathon, a 10km race, a 5km race, and a shorter 3km race, allowing participants of different fitness levels and experience to select the distance that suits them best.

faqs.question: Who organizes the CIDB Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: The CIDB Half Marathon is organized by Kelab CIDB WP Kuala Lumpur, operating under the name "CIDB Run." This organizing club is responsible for coordinating the event, which takes place at Dataran Putrajaya in Putrajaya, Malaysia.
